The Duchess has left it broken as a reminder of aggressive action.|An [[RIC-series general labor droid/Legends|RIC-series droid]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>}}
The '''Memorial Shrine''' was located in [[Peace Park/Legends|Peace Park]] in [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]].

==History==
The Memorial Shrine was [[Attack on the Memorial Shrine/Legends|bombed]] by a [[Death Watch bomber/Legends|member]] of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the bombing, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] chose to leave it in shambles to remind her people, the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], about the dangers of aggressive action.
